window.tick_derivation: Every live sample has publication_ticks=1; certified begin/end heads confirm constant logical_end−segment_id.
window.sample_skew: Controller methods are separate queries a few seconds apart. One in-flight publication/message can cross endpoints; per-tick values are window averages, not an atomic charge ledger.

instruction_attribution.attribution_limits: Instruction phases are measured, cycle equivalents modelled with documented fee schedule; actual debit is balance-based. Residual includes host/root reads, Coordinator restore/validation before phase counters, other timer callbacks, source/treasury, base/call/byte charges and unmeasured work. No exact current source-vs-treasury cycle split is claimed. Persist includes encoding/hashing/stable writes and certification, not just storage rent. No cumulative total-message instruction counter exists; last/max cannot be summed over the window.

world.cost_change_vs_earlier_two_ball_release: Three active balls now cross the 512-unit Step budget, requiring multiple Step operations and about two working messages/publication. Earlier two-ball rates are not comparable at unchanged workload.

local_profile.native_qualification: CPU microbenchmark, not Wasm cycles. Same captured state replayed; checkpoint timing includes explicit cursor boundaries, does not replicate every host/DTR validation. No production budget increase is proposed.

historical_comparison_since_pre_frontend.qualification: Two discrete credits before the window, not continuing income. The 10-minute measurement window had zero new receipts or credits.

forecast_qualification: Current three-ball measured total cycles/tick extrapolated to nominal rates with current one-tick publications. Fixed overhead is folded into this calibration; no independent current v5 fixed-overhead intercept is known. Results are workload-dependent scenarios, not proven sustainable rates under arbitrary population/fragmentation. Receipt yield is the last observed 1-ICP conversion, not a future exchange-rate or income guarantee.

runway.warning: No future treasury credit is assumed. Query-liquid scenarios use configured hysteresis thresholds; callback execution reserves and workload changes can cause earlier transitions. Reserve Protection can gate paid gameplay/admission while maintenance continues. No funding or pacing change is authorised or initiated.

ranked_optimisation_proposal.change: Prototype reuse of immutable, already-validated cursor/coordinator bytes within a single message; reduce redundant canonical decode/encode, hashing and output revalidation without removing trust-boundary checks.
ranked_optimisation_proposal.evidence: Step is the largest bucket; host.restore is before phase counters; DTR restore/propose/post-propose and kernel cursor/result repeatedly validate canonical snapshots. Native checkpoint codec accounts for 38.7% of combined raw-Step/checkpoint CPU time.
ranked_optimisation_proposal.ceiling: Step plus residual is a broad upper bound, not removable cost.
ranked_optimisation_proposal.complexity: medium-high; likely B2Z/DTR internal interfaces, separate upstream review if DTR changes
ranked_optimisation_proposal.state_preservation_risk: medium; cache keyed by exact immutable commitment, discarded on mutation/upgrade; corruption and schema checks remain mandatory
ranked_optimisation_proposal.determinism: Exact public output and corruption/recovery equivalence required; no arithmetic, ownership or physics changes.

ranked_optimisation_proposal.change: Reuse result/manifest/artifact encoding work across ready validation, Publish and certified observation preparation, keyed by exact cursor/seal hashes.
ranked_optimisation_proposal.evidence: Publish estimated execution 0.414T/hour; Step also computes result/ready manifest and validation may recompute it.
ranked_optimisation_proposal.state_preservation_risk: medium; never reuse across a different cursor/seal/publication; retain all exact certified bytes and historical formats
ranked_optimisation_proposal.determinism: Require byte-identical v8 publication, seal, state/events/scores, artifact chunks and replay.

ranked_optimisation_proposal.change: Compare unchanged image chunks or reuse encoded descriptors before stable writes; retain identical coordinator snapshot bytes, key layout and atomic commit semantics.
ranked_optimisation_proposal.evidence: Persist is a measured 0.192T/hour execution bucket, not pure storage rent; slot-0 coordinator image is rewritten each working callback.
ranked_optimisation_proposal.state_preservation_risk: low-medium if stable layout is unchanged; interruption/upgrade/recovery tests are mandatory
ranked_optimisation_proposal.determinism: Logical output unchanged; durable image and publication integrity must remain equal.

ranked_optimisation_proposal.change: After codec costs are isolated, profile and reduce exact rational-arithmetic allocations and repeated collision candidate calculations while preserving candidate order and tie-breaking.
ranked_optimisation_proposal.evidence: Native raw simulation remains substantial; Step includes other costs, so no measured pure-physics cycle share is claimed.
ranked_optimisation_proposal.state_preservation_risk: medium-high due to event ordering and edge cases
ranked_optimisation_proposal.determinism: No floats/approximation, changed cell geometry or changed results; require full differential fixtures, torus seams, collisions and retained replay.

ranked_optimisation_proposal.change: Defer source/treasury/timer tuning; investigate only the remaining residual after the dominant pipeline costs are reduced. Preserve exact polling, payment and funding behavior.
ranked_optimisation_proposal.evidence: 10 Index calls / 10 minutes, no pending records; treasury nonce rose only twice, no financial operation or replenishment in the window. Historical empty-world PocketIC control is small but is not current v5 attribution.
ranked_optimisation_proposal.complexity: undetermined; not justified as first optimisation
ranked_optimisation_proposal.state_preservation_risk: high relative to likely gain for payment/source changes
ranked_optimisation_proposal.determinism: No poll interval, source cursor, financial semantics or pacing change proposed.

proposal_limits: Savings ranges are screening targets grounded in measured bucket ceilings, NOT measured improvements or additive promises. Before any implementation/deployment, approve a narrow prototype and require same-input/same-output and frozen-predecessor upgrade/recovery conformance. No authoritative algorithm or budget/pacing change has been implemented.
